run_validation: run validation on a fairnr model checkpoint using the CLI with --path and --valid-subset flags
run_distributed_validation: run multi-GPU distributed validation across all available GPUs using the validate CLI entry point
run_fp16_validation: run validation with FP16 precision enabled using the --fp16 flag for faster inference
review_main_function: review the main validation function that loads models, builds criteria, and iterates over validation subsets
review_cli_main: review the cli_main function that parses validation arguments and dispatches to distributed validation
